mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Corporate UBO or Parent Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry of the jurisdiction in which the corporate UBO or parent shareholder is incorporated
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route if the shareholder's home jurisdiction is a party to the Apostille Convention: notarize the certified extract, then obtain an Apostille certificate from the home jurisdiction's designated Competent Authority, and submit directly to PRC SAMR and banks; do not add Chinese consular legalization. Non-member route if the shareholder's home jurisdiction is not an Apostille state: notarize the extract, obtain authentication from the home jurisdiction's Ministry of Foreign Affairs or equivalent authority, then obtain consular legalization from the Embassy or Consulate of the People's Republic of China in that home jurisdiction; do not use an Apostille. Select exactly one route based on treaty membership; never chain Apostille and consular legalization sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Presence of the Corporate UBO or Parent Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Same competent companies registry or tax registry that maintains the corporate UBO's status records
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route if the home jurisdiction is an Apostille Convention state: notarize, then apostille through the relevant Competent Authority, then submit to PRC authorities; no consular legalization. Non-member route if not an Apostille state: notarize, authenticate through the home jurisdiction's foreign affairs authority, then legalize through the PRC Embassy or Consulate in that jurisdiction; no Apostille. These alternatives are parallel and mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney authorizing establishment of the WFOE, appointment of legal representative and first directors, and bank account opening
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the corporate UBO or parent shareholder acting under its constitutional documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route if the board resolution is executed in an Apostille Convention state: notarized copy, Apostille by the competent state authority, direct acceptance by PRC SAMR, banks, and notaries. Non-member route: notarized copy, authentication by the competent government authority of the home jurisdiction, then consular legalization by PRC Embassy or Consulate in the home jurisdiction. The chosen route must match the jurisdiction of execution only; do not combine both routes.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association or Constitutional Documents of the Corporate UBO or Parent Shareholder (certified copy)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry or corporate secretary of the corporate UBO or parent shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille route: certified copy notarized and apostilled by the home jurisdiction's Competent Authority under the Hague Apostille Convention; no PRC consular legalization. Consular route: certified copy notarized, authenticated by the home jurisdiction's government authority, then legalized by the PRC Consulate or Embassy with territorial jurisdiction; no Apostille. The two authentication systems are separate and mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter issued for the corporate UBO or parent shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Principal commercial bank where the corporate UBO or parent shareholder maintains its operating account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille route if the issuing bank's country is an Apostille state: original bank letter notarized, then apostilled by the country's Competent Authority, then submitted to PRC counterparties and banks; no consular legalization. Non-member route: original bank letter notarized, authenticated by the relevant home-government office, then consular legalized by the PRC Embassy or Consulate in that country; no Apostille. Only one route applies, depending on the issuing state's Hague membership status.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Every corporate and natural person UBO, legal representative, director, supervisor, senior manager, authorized signatory, beneficiary, and material counterparty must be screened in real time against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN and non-SDN sanctions lists, EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions lists, PRC terrorist organization and sanctions designations, and World Bank debarment list. Politically exposed persons (PEPs), including foreign and domestic PEPs, and their immediate family members and close associates require enhanced due diligence, independent verification of source of funds and source of wealth, senior management approval for onboarding, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Adverse media, enforcement actions, and regulatory disqualification searches must be completed before engagement and refreshed quarterly.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Name Registration Management System (online enterprise registration portal integrated with the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered company name must be in simplified Chinese characters and follow the statutory four-tier naming structure: administrative division, distinctive trade name, industry or business characteristics, and organization form (limited liability company or company). Pinyin, romanized letters, or foreign scripts may not replace the Chinese legal name. A foreign-language name may be adopted separately only after the Chinese name is approved, must be registered and filed, and must not conflict with prior protected trademarks or public policy. Foreign investor names for UBO identification are transliterated phonetically in registration filings, but the approved Chinese trade name may be a coined or dictionary term.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If SAMR rejects a proposed name, the applicant must first obtain the written rejection notice stating the legal basis. Within 15 calendar days from receipt of that notice, the applicant may apply for administrative reconsideration to the next higher SAMR authority under the Administrative Reconsideration Law. Alternatively, the applicant may file an administrative lawsuit with the competent people's court within six months. The appeal should identify the rejected name, application number, statutory ground, and any corrective facts. If the rejection is based on similarity to an existing name, the applicant may submit a written prior-rights settlement, consent, or authorization letter, or propose a new distinctive trade name and resubmit. Time limits and evidence preservation are critical.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible as the registered address of a PRC WFOE. SAMR, municipal tax authorities, and commercial banks uniformly reject virtual addresses for a new company registration, tax registration, and corporate bank account opening. The WFOE must maintain a fixed physical office within the registered administrative district, evidenced by a valid lease contract and property ownership certificate, and the address must be the actual place of management and business operations. For a subtitle post-production and AI dubbing studio, the registered premises must house the equipment, workstations, servers, and personnel used for the declared business; a bare mailbox will also fail beneficial owner compliance and annual reporting checks.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: (1) signed lease for at least one year with property ownership certificate; (2) physical presence of staff and equipment during business hours; (3) company name plates and signage; (4) VAT invoices matching declared revenue; (5) bank statements reconciling with sales contracts; (6) social insurance and employment contract records; (7) server and production equipment inventory; (8) complete UBO and corporate governance files. Quantified risk: approximately 30% likelihood of an unannounced municipal tax bureau inspection within the first 24 months of operation, and approximately 20% likelihood of a market regulation authority on-site verification following the first annual report filing. The risk increases materially if the registered address is residential, shared without a formal sublease, or inconsistent with the declared industry.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 4, 23, 24-31, 46-50, 58, 83-85; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 4, 9, 28, 29; Regulations on the Administration of Market Entity Registration (State Council Order No. 746), Articles 2-11.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) / local Municipal Market Regulation Administration
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Establishment Registration Application Form and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed for an ordinary wholly foreign-owned enterprise under the PRC Foreign Investment Law or Company Law. The foreign investor fixes a registered capital amount and a capital contribution schedule in the Articles of Association, with full payment required no later than five years after establishment under the 2023 Company Law (effective 1 July 2024). No blocked escrow account requirement applies to this digital post-production business scope.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: WHEREAS, [Company Name] (the Company) was incorporated in the People's Republic of China as a wholly foreign-owned limited liability company, with registered capital fixed by the sole shareholder and governance pursuant to the Company Law of the PRC and the Articles of Association; and WHEREAS, the Board of Directors desires to put the statutory management of the Company in order. NOW THEREFORE, the Board of Directors, having satisfied the quorum and notice requirements, hereby passes the following resolutions: (A) Share Capital Subscription. The issuance and subscription of registered capital is approved in the nominal amount of [●] United States Dollars or Renminbi, divided into [●] shares with equal nominal value, subscribed by the shareholder and recorded in the register of members. The legal representative and the General Manager are jointly directed to collect the capital contributions at such times and in such amounts as set out in the capital contribution schedule, to deposit all proceeds in the Company's dedicated foreign direct investment capital account, and to prepare lawful contribution certificates and filing statements for submission to the State Administration for Market Regulation and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange. (B) Banking Authorization. The opening of a basic Renminbi deposit account, a foreign currency capital account, and any ancillary settlement account with a commercial bank selected by the legal representative is authorized. The legal representative and Chief Financial Officer are approved as the authorized signatories, and no amount may be moved without the joint signature of any two of the authorized signatories or such single-signature threshold as the Board may delegate for operational costs below US$10,000. (C) Registered Office Adoption. The registered office at [Full Address] is adopted as the statutory address and principal place of business. The legal representative is authorized to execute a lease, obtain the certificate of ownership from the lessor, serve all administrative notices, and register the address with the competent Market Regulation Administration. (D) Statutory Officer Appointments. The Board appoints [Name] as legal representative, executive director and Chairman, [Name] as Supervisor, [Name] as General Manager, and [Name] as Chief Financial Officer, each to serve until a successor is duly appointed. Each officer is empowered to sign and execute all instruments, applications, employment contracts, and regulatory communications, and to delegate transitory powers where required. (E) Implementation and Indemnity. The Board directs the officers to take all actions necessary to complete tax registration, seal engraving, social insurance registration, office permits, and licensing, including any future application required for AI voice or deep synthesis services. The Company shall indemnify each officer when acting in good faith, and no officer may be liable for any act done in reliance on legal counsel. These resolutions take effect immediately and may be produced to any government authority as conclusive evidence of board approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Pre-Approval and Foreign Investor Credential Curing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the National Enterprise Name Announcement System or the local Municipal Market Regulation Administration online service portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a name availability search using at least three proposed commercial names, confirm no identical or infringing registered name in the State Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System, and verify that the proposed name complies with the Enterprise Name Registration Administration Provisions. If the shareholder is an artificial person, obtain a notarized and legalized certificate of incorporation, apostilled Convention apostille or Chinese consular legalization, have the document translated into Chinese by a licensed translator, and attach the certificate to the name reservation application. Reserve the approved name with a validity period of six months.
required_dossiers: Notarized and legalized foreign shareholder identity or registration certificate
Chinese translation certificate
Three proposed company names
Power of attorney appointing local filing agent
Lease intent letter for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name application is returned, correct the naming elements, provide consent letters or disclaimers from prior rights holders, and re-submit within five working days; if rejected after resubmission, apply for administrative reconsideration before the SAMR.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of WFOE Establishment Application and Business License Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Regulation Administration certificate window and the provincial enterprise registration e-window operated by SAMR
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete and execute the Company Establishment Registration Application Form, Articles of Association, appointment instruments for legal representative, executive director or supervisor, senior management, and office lease certificate. Use a capitalization schedule reflecting total registered capital and the final payment deadline not exceeding five years for general industry. The authorized representative must submit original or scanned documents to the local Market Regulation Administration, with electronic identification and signature completed. The Administration examines the permitted business scope and, if accurate, issues the Business License. After issuance, the Company must make the establishment announcement in the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and protect the license number from unauthorized use.
required_dossiers: Company Establishment Registration Application Form
Articles of Association executed by the shareholder
Foreign investor legalized certificate and Chinese translation
Power of attorney and agent identification
Office lease certificate with property ownership evidence
Name pre-approval notice
Identification and appointment instruments of legal representative and supervisor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If supplemental information is requested, respond in writing within fifteen working days with the exact requested attachment. If the application is rejected, the Company may file an administrative reconsideration or an administrative lawsuit in the competent court, or correct the business scope and re-file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Seal Engraving, Tax Registration and Social Insurance Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Public Security Bureau-approved seal engraving unit; State Taxation Administration local office; Human Resources and Social Security Bureau
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Business License is issued, make and file the company seal, finance seal, legal representative seal and contract seal through a public-security designated engraving unit, and keep the seal record with the public security organ. Then complete tax registration by filing the taxpayer information, accounting system, and bank deposit account under the New Tax E-Service Portal; elect general or small-scale taxpayer status and apply for electronic invoices. Simultaneously register the Company as an employer for social insurance and housing fund, adding expatriate and local employees and establishing contribution accounts.
required_dossiers: Business License original and copy
Company seal and finance seal records
Legal representative and financial officer identity documents
Articles of Association and officer appointment resolution
Bank account information or after-opening supplement letter
Tax registration information form and social insurance employer registration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a registration is suspended, reconcile the taxpayer identity with the unified social credit code, correct any mismatch in the social insurance contributor register, and submit a voluntary correction notice to the online tax authority to minimize late filing exposure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening, Foreign Direct Investment Foreign Exchange Registration and Capital Contribution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) through a SAFE-designated bank; People's Bank of China clearing system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a Renminbi basic deposit account and a foreign currency capital account at an authorized bank after Business License issuance. The bank completes the foreign direct investment information registration in the SAFE capital project information system by uploading the business license, Articles of Association and board resolution. The overseas shareholder wires the committed capital to the foreign currency capital account with the remittance purpose stating inbound direct investment. After receipt, the Company may settle the foreign exchange into Renminbi for genuine operating expenditures under the capital project intended-use rules, and record each settlement in the foreign exchange settlement account system.
required_dossiers: Business License with unified social credit code
Company seals and official chop register
Articles of Association and first board resolution
FDI foreign exchange registration form (bank-specific form FD1)
Bank account opening certificate / basic deposit account code
Capital contribution remittance receipt and bank statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank reports a discrepancy in FDI information, submit a correction within ten working days together with the capital flow certificate. If a remittance is delayed beyond the contribution schedule, file a voluntary change to the capital contribution schedule with the shareholder resolution and submit it to the bank; if the bank denies the correction, apply for administrative review before the SAFE branch.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Industry Classification Confirmation and Digital-Content Regulatory Health Check
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Market Regulation Administration for classification records; National Radio and Television Administration and Ministry of Industry and Information Technology only if an ancillary license becomes legally necessary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Review the registered business scope to ensure it exactly covers ISIC 5912 (motion picture, video and television programme post-production), NAICS 512191, and the automated subtitle transcription and AI voice cloning services described in the operating agreements. For pure digital B2B post-production there is no factory, warehouse, chemical process or physical infrastructure, thus no environmental assessment or Civil Defense permit is triggered. Maintain an internal record of AI deep-synthesis and algorithm decision-making in accordance with the Measures for the Management of Deep Synthesis Internet Information Services, including labeling of synthetic voices and subtitles, and retain consent records from voice donors and intellectual property licensing records.
required_dossiers: Business License with approved scope
Tax and social insurance registration certificates
AI deep synthesis labeling and self-assessment policy
Client service agreements for post-production work
IP and publicity-rights license register
Lease certificate for the office or production studio
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the local authority reclassifies the activity as media production requiring a Radio and Television Program Production and Operation Permit, apply to the provincial National Radio and Television Administration office within the allotted response period; if the algorithm filing is queried, submit a supplementary technical description and risk-assurance commitment through the algorithm filing system within five working days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable for ISIC 5912 digital post-production and AI studio; no industrial licensing board jurisdiction over this office-based activity
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable (no physical manufacturing, chemical, assembly, or warehousing operation; digital service activity only)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable - Ministry of Ecology and Environment project filing is not triggered by digital post-production services
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (no EIA category) - no construction works, industrial installation, wastewater discharge, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste generation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable - zero industrial wastewater, zero process VOCs, and zero hazardous waste; ordinary municipal domestic sewage and office waste are governed by municipal utilities and local sanitation regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable for pure digital office occupancy; no Civil Defense air-raid shelter permit or hazardous-occupancy clearance is required. If tenant fit-out is undertaken, the local Fire and Rescue Department issues a simple fire safety inspection opinion for office use only.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; all filings, VAT invoice issuance, and zero-rating/refund applications are executed through the nationwide Electronic Tax Bureau (etax.chinatax.gov.cn) and the STA Electronic Invoice Service Platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The WFOE obtains its Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) from the local Administration for Market Regulation at incorporation. Under the multi-license integration system, the USCC is the only statutory tax identification number; no separate VAT registration certificate is issued. The incorporation record is automatically transmitted to the STA to create the electronic tax file. Within the legally prescribed post-incorporation period, the company must complete its taxpayer classification (small-scale or general VAT taxpayer), register its financial accounting and cost-reporting policies, file its bank deposit account details, and activate fully digital e-invoice issuance capability in the Electronic Tax Bureau. If a foreign non-resident counterparty that has no Chinese establishment is engaged, that counterparty must provide its foreign TIN and, where seeking treaty benefits or performing withholding-related obligations, must separately obtain a Chinese non-resident tax identification number from the competent STA office before the relevant payment or refund claim. For the WFOE itself, no additional TIN application is required; the USCC appearing on the business license is the definitive TIN used for all VAT, customs, EIT, and withholding activities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None (no US-style check-the-box, CFC classification election, or hybrid mismatch election exists for a WFOE; it is mandatorily classified as a PRC resident enterprise. The only relevant elections are VAT-related: a below-threshold supplier may voluntarily elect general VAT taxpayer status, and a qualifying corporate restructuring may elect special tax treatment under the Enterprise Income Tax Law, but neither changes the entity's default tax classification).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT), administered under the Provisional Regulations on Value-Added Tax and the comprehensive VAT pilot Notice (Cai Shui [2016] No. 36).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: CNY 5,000,000 of annual taxable sales: exceeding this turnover makes general VAT taxpayer registration mandatory. VAT payment registration itself is required of all WFOEs from the date of business license irrespective of turnover; monthly sales of CNY 100,000 or less may qualify for the small-scale taxpayer exemption currently in force, but this does not remove the registration and tax identity obligation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The STA mandates fully digital electronic invoices (Digital E-Invoices) issued via the Electronic Invoice Service Platform, integrated with the Golden Tax Phase IV system. Every invoice must be transmitted to and cleared by the STA at issuance, and the system generates a unique tax control code and digital stamp for anti-counterfeiting. Traditional tax-control equipment is being phased into this unified platform; where still used, the VAT invoice management system must be reconciled with the VAT return before monthly filing. Real-time data exchange via the STA standard data interface is available for ERP integration and makes invoice, contract, and settlement data available to the audit system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For the AI subtitle transcription and voice-cloning studio, 0% VAT is claimable only if the service is correctly characterised and contracted as a cross-border software service, information-system service, R&D/technical service, or another category expressly listed for zero-rating in Cai Shui [2016] No. 36 Annex 4, where the recipient is a non-resident enterprise and the service is consumed entirely outside mainland China. Services that fall under post-production broadcasting, film, television programme production, or cultural-creative services will generally qualify for exemption rather than zero-rating, meaning input VAT cannot be refunded. The WFOE must establish all five elements: foreign recipient, foreign consumption, foreign currency consideration, successful repatriation of proceeds, and delivery or production evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: For physical goods exported by the WFOE: PRC Customs Export Goods Declaration (Export Bill of Entry), the signed Bill of Lading or airway bill, and the bank's export collection/foreign exchange receipt voucher.

For cross-border services: the executed cross-border service contract specifying price, intellectual property ownership, service scope and delivery terms; the issued Digital E-Invoice marked at 0% or exempt; a foreign exchange inward remittance voucher from a PRC-designated bank (foreign exchange collection receipt); proof of the overseas recipient's non-resident status using its foreign tax registration number and registered address; and objective evidence of offshore consumption such as project locus records, IP logs, overseas screen deliverables, or client sign-off.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA and Customs jointly apply Golden Tax Phase IV audit analytics to export zero-rating claims. If supporting documentation is missing, inconsistent, or fraudulent, the zero-rated output VAT is reactivated, the corresponding input VAT refund is clawed back, overdue interest is charged, and, under Article 63 of the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection and Tax Levy, an administrative penalty of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax may be imposed. Fraudulent export VAT refund claims are also subject to criminal liability under the Criminal Law's export-rebate fraud provisions; principals and responsible officers may face imprisonment and additional fines.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC), as the central bank, with foreign-exchange regulatory power delegated to the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Mainland China operates a managed floating exchange-rate regime with cautious capital-account liberalization. The RMB is fully convertible on trade-related current operations, including software services, royalties, and audio post-production disbursements, only after banks verify the underlying transaction documents. The capital account remains restricted: foreign direct investment into a WFOE requires SAFE registration evidenced by an FDI code, but once registered, inward equity remittances may settle into RMB through the designated bank. Profit repatriation is permitted annually after audited financial statements and corporate income-tax final settlement; the bank reviews the dividend resolution, audited profits, tax payment certificates, and a foreign-exchange declaration before purchasing FX. Surrender requirements no longer mandate forced conversion; exporters retain proceeds in FX accounts or convert at will. Remittances for artificial-intelligence subtitling and voice-cloning services are subject to service-trade verification, including contracts and invoices, to ensure current-account authenticity. The overall assessment is that current-account proceeds are effectively convertible through banks under a real-need principle, while capital flows are scheme-based and monitored by SAFE's digital system, making silent quota avoidance and round-tripping high-risk. For an AI subtitle and dubbing studio, contract granularity, invoice consistency, and IP licensing documentation are the decisive convertibility gateways.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Goods and services exporters are required to repatriate foreign-currency receipts to a licensed domestic bank or hold them in an approved offshore account. SAFE trade monitoring requires declaration of any collection period beyond 90 days from the export reporting reference as deferred collection; actual receipt is driven by the commercial payment terms, but the bank must be able to match the invoice and the underlying sale. Mandatory conversion ratio: 0%; there is no forced surrender of export proceeds. The exporter may retain USD or other foreign currency in a current-account FX account or settle into RMB at market rate. All settlements require matching contract, invoice, customs or service transaction records, and if any mismatch appears, the bank will suspend settlement and request a written explanation.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Capital Escrow and Settlement Account plus Basic Operational Currency Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Operational Currency Account and Foreign-Currency Receipts Account
Basic Operational Currency Account with Trade Settlement Rails
Basic Operational Currency Account as Backup Clearing Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low. PRC banking regulations reserve domestic RMB deposit-taking, foreign-exchange settlement, and SAFE-registered capital-account processes to licensed banks. Cross-border digital EMI providers such as Wise and Stripe do not hold a mainland China banking or payment-institution license capable of servicing a WFOE as a domestic operational account provider. They cannot legally open a CNY settlement account, execute an FDI capital injection narrative, or file SAFE reporting on behalf of a mainland entity. Stripe and Wise may only be used by an affiliated offshore holding company to collect overseas card receipts, but those funds must be repatriated to the mainland WFOE through a licensed bank channel. They are not a substitute for tier-1 commercial bank onboarding.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In practice, the legal representative, or a senior officer explicitly authorized by a notarized power of attorney, must appear in person at the mainland bank branch for the basic deposit account opening and the AML face-to-face interview. Many banks also require live video verification. Remote consular proxy opening alone is not permitted as a standalone route. For foreign directors, the passport and incorporation documents must be notarized and legalized in the home jurisdiction, translated into Chinese, and presented with the original authorization documents at the branch. If the legal representative cannot travel, the bank may accept a notarized power of attorney plus physical appearance by the authorized officer, but some banks still require the legal representative to attend at least one in-branch interview before activating high-value foreign-exchange and outward remittance services.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner opacity and a multi-layer offshore holding chain surrounding the WFOE, making it difficult for the bank to identify the natural persons who ultimately control the entity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Up-to-date corporate registry extracts and registers of members for every holding layer, notarized and apostilled plus translated into Chinese; passport copies and tax identification numbers of each ultimate beneficial owner; a signed UBO declaration; a board resolution naming the authorized representative; and audited financial statements of the immediate parent company for the last two years.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border capital injection source mismatch, where the contributing shareholder is a recently incorporated or shell-like special-purpose vehicle in Hong Kong or another offshore jurisdiction with no operating history.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements of the shareholder for the past two to three years; original bank statements in the funding account showing accumulated operating surplus; share subscription and investment agreement; certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing; group reorganisation memorandum if the contribution is funded by an intra-group loan or internal cash transfer; and a written source-of-funds questionnaire signed by the beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business-model mismatch around AI dubbing, subtitle transcription, and voice cloning, raising concerns about unlicensed media distribution, data privacy, intellectual-property infringement, or royalty misclassification.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master service agreements with production companies or streaming platforms; commercial invoices and delivery schedules proving subtitle and voice deliverables; statutory copyright and trademark registrations; a written business-scope explanation aligned with ISIC 5912 and NAICS 512191; AI-training data provenance and consent records; and lawful platform payment settlement reports demonstrating the legitimate global revenue collection chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, or adverse-media screening hits triggered by a politically exposed official in the shareholder structure or by identity data mismatches in passport, residence, and nationality.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent AML screening output from a commercial due-diligence database such as Dow Jones or Refinitiv World-Check; a documented explanation of any PEP status and exit status; court clearance and police clearance letters; source-of-wealth documentation including audited financial statements and tax returns; passport copies with entry stamps; and tax compliance certificates from the applicable jurisdiction.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity injections must travel from the overseas shareholder's own bank account to the WFOE's SAFE-registered FDI capital account in mainland China using SWIFT MT103. The remittance instruction must state the SAFE FDI registration code and use the BOP receipt transaction code for direct-investment equity injection, commonly 621011, with confirmation from the receiving bank at time of placement. No capital contribution may be received on a personal account or routed through Wise or Stripe. The WFOE must first complete the FDI basic-information registration through its designated tier-1 bank. After receipt, a licensed certified public accountant issues a capital verification report confirming the contribution against the shareholder resolution and updated Articles of Association. The foreign currency may then be settled into RMB at the bank's spot rate within the capital settlement policy, and the settlement proceeds must be placed in a RMB capital account and used only for lawful operating and investment purposes. The bank will file the maintenance record and later cross-check it with annual SAFE reporting, dividend remittance, and disposal of the WFOE equity.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For outbound subtitle transcription, audio dubbing, voice-cloning, and post-production service payments, the primary clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 for service-trade remittances. The WFOE must submit a service-trade foreign-exchange payment application, the signed service agreement, a commercial invoice, the relevant tax withholding or corporate income-tax payment certificate, and a calculation of royalties or licence fees. If physical media products are exported, Commercial Letters of Credit and documentary collections can be used through the bank's trade-services desk, but the AI service revenue model is dominated by cross-border wire transfers. Open-account settlement terms must be declared when the payment date extends beyond 90 days, and the bank will verify the transaction against SAFE's trade monitoring system. Wise and Stripe cannot be used as the statutory clearing rail for domestic supplier disbursements, SAFE filings, or tax-related payments from the mainland WFOE.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable FX forward contracts with genuine current-account exposure evidenced by invoices and contracts, no speculative short positions
FX swaps between CNY and foreign currency for cash-flow timing differences in commercial settlement receipts and disbursements
Cross-currency swaps for long-term capital-account exposure, such as shareholder loans or refinancing structures, subject to bank approval and SAFE registration
Vanilla FX options purchased from a licensed bank to hedge adverse CNY/USD movements, limited to the notional amount of the underlying receivable or payable
Non-deliverable forward contracts are not permissible onshore for a mainland WFOE; offshore CNH NDF cannot replace the domestic real-cash-flow settlement requirement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Information Report (annual business operation declaration filed through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Each calendar year from January 1 to June 30 (local China time), covering the immediately preceding fiscal year; final deadline is June 30 at 23:59
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If the report is not filed by June 30, the company is automatically placed on the List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operations after the SAMR publication process. The company may apply for correction and removal within 3 years from inclusion; if the default is not remedied within 3 years, SAMR moves the company to the List of Seriously Illegal Enterprises, triggering joint disciplinary restrictions in government procurement, credit ratings, tax facilitation, market access, and financial licensing. The legal representative and senior executives may be disqualified for 3 years. If business operations do not commence or cease for six consecutive months after license issuance, SAMR may administratively revoke the business license and initiate strike-off / compulsory deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Information Report for the Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) jointly with State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the Foreign Investment Information Reporting System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 to June 30 each year for the prior-year reporting period; event-based changes in foreign investment equity, shareholding transfers, or beneficial ownership must be reported within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file by June 30, or submission of false, incomplete, or misleading information, triggers a written administrative rectification order from MOFCOM/SAMR. If the enterprise does not rectify, it may be added to the enterprise credit abnormal list and fined up to RMB 100,000. Continued default can result in cross-agency restrictions on foreign exchange, customs clearance, tax incentives, and other business facilitation measures; chronic inactivity may lead to license revocation and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Final Settlement and Payment (Annual CIT reconciliation and return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) through the local competent tax authority and its e-taxation filing platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before May 31 of the year immediately following the tax year; quarterly provisional CIT prepayments are due within 15 days after each quarter-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing of the annual CIT return: the tax authority orders rectification within a prescribed time limit and may impose a fine of up to RMB 2,000, or RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 in serious circumstances. Late payment of the annual tax liability: a daily overdue surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid tax applies from the statutory deadline until payment. Substantial continued delinquency after tax inspection demands can lead to asset freezing, tax preservation, enforced seizure and sale of assets, cancellation of tax registration, and, where the enterprise has ceased activity for six consecutive months, revocation of the business license by SAMR.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under Article 164 of the PRC Company Law, every limited liability company, including a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise, must prepare annual financial reports at the end of each fiscal year and have them independently audited by an accounting firm. PRC law applies a universal audit mandate rather than quantitative size-based thresholds; therefore there is no balance-sheet, turnover, or headcount exemption for an ordinary WFOE. Additional mandatory audit triggers apply if the entity is listed, issues public securities, operates as a financial institution, receives state investment subsidies, or is selected for special regulatory inspection. Foreign-invested enterprise annual reporting also contemplates audited financial statements as credible evidence of disclosed foreign investment information.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS / ASBE) issued by the Ministry of Finance, substantially converged with IFRS; small-scale qualifying enterprises may elect the Ministry of Finance Accounting Standards for Small Enterprises, but a WFOE is normally expected to apply full CAS because of its foreign-invested corporate status and audit expectations.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the PRC Foreign Investment Information Reporting Measures, the WFOE does not operate a separate standalone annual UBO confirmation certificate; however, it must file an event-based foreign investment information report within 30 days of any shareholding transfer or change in ultimate beneficial ownership/control. In addition, the annual enterprise information report filed between January 1 and June 30 must restate current shareholders and actual controllers. Failure to update within the 30-day event window or failure to include accurate beneficial ownership information in the annual report may lead to inclusion in the abnormal operations list, credit penalties, and administrative fines up to RMB 100,000.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Charges/Mortgages (where debt charges exist; otherwise maintained for creditor notifications)
Minute Book of Shareholder General Meetings and Board Meetings
Company seal, contract, and official chop register
Financial accounting records and annual audited financial statements

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 - 4,800 per year for a registered-virtual office address in a Tier-1 Chinese city; physical office lease is typically USD 8,000 - 30,000 per year where an operational presence is required
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - 8,000 per year for a WFOE engaged in subtitle post-production and AI voice services, depending on asset size, revenue volume, and international payment transaction complexity

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying High and New Technology Enterprises may enjoy a reduced 15% rate; Small Low-Profit Enterprises (annual taxable income not exceeding RMB 3 million, fewer than 300 employees, and total assets not exceeding RMB 50 million) benefit from an effective 5% rate on taxable income under current preferential policies; additional 100% super deduction for eligible R&D expenses (i.e., 200% of qualifying R&D expenditure is deductible); newly established software enterprises meeting criteria may qualify for the 'two-year exemption, three-year half-rate' holiday; no general patent box regime exists, but specific IP-related tax incentives are available for integrated circuit and software enterprises.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Class A) — Form A100000 (and associated schedules A105000, A107010, A107041, etc.), filed electronically via the State Taxation Administration's e-Tax filing portal (电子税务局 / e-Taxain).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual filing, with quarterly provisional CIT returns (Form A200000) due within 15 days after each quarter end.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return must be filed within five months after the end of the fiscal year (i.e., by May 31 of the following year for a calendar-year enterprise). Quarterly provisional returns are due by the 15th day of the month following each calendar quarter.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue recognized from the AI subtitle transcription, dubbing, and post-production services, including all related ancillary income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all revenue from both domestic and cross-border customers. For payments received from non-residents for services provided inside or outside China, ensure that the scope of underlying taxable activities is correctly reported and that any offshore revenue is disclosed to permit tax authorities to assess whether a China sourced income or permanent establishment issue exists. Cross-border service contracts with affiliated parties must reflect arm's length pricing. If the company performs services for foreign parent entities, the revenue must not be understated to shift profit offshore.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs attributable to service delivery, including license fees for AI voice-cloning software, subtitling tools, cloud computing costs, subcontractor labor, and royalties or content access fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductibility of costs paid to non-residents is contingent on valid tax invoices (Fapiao) or fiscally acceptable vouchers and proper withholding of WHT on cross-border royalties and interest. Where the company pays for intangibles or technical services from offshore affiliates, it must obtain contemporaneous transfer pricing substantiation and withhold the relevant withholding taxes; otherwise, the deduction may be denied. Royalty fees paid to a tax-haven shell company will be treated as non-deductible if the recipient lacks economic substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjustments that increase taxable income, including disallowed expenses, excessive entertainment costs, non-compliant intercompany charges, and transfer pricing adjustments initiated by the tax bureau.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For cross-border transactions, any intercompany payment not at arm's length is subject to upward adjustment. Under Article 41 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law, the tax authority may re-determine taxable income if a foreign-owned enterprise conducts transactions with related parties that do not follow the arm's length principle. Amounts include the portion of royalty and interest payments that exceed the limit if treaty or domestic law restricts deductibility, and penalties for late or non-withholding of tax on non-resident payments. Ensure that any foreign tax credit or treaty position is properly documented.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount of prior-year cumulative tax losses utilized to offset current-year taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A general five-year carryforward applies, extended to ten years for qualifying High and New Technology Enterprises or Small and Medium Sci-Tech Enterprises. When a WFOE's foreign shareholder restructures or transfers ownership, the continuity-of-business and beneficial-interest tests must be satisfied to preserve loss carryforwards. Losses incurred by a foreign branch cannot be offset against Chinese profits unless separately permitted under tax treaties or domestic regulations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 / Line 21: Tax Reduction and Exemption Amount
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reduction from the headline 25% rate due to preferential regimes, e.g., High and New Technology Enterprise 15% rate, small low-profit enterprise reduced rates, and super deductions for R&D.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claiming preferential rates requires valid certificates, such as the High and New Technology Enterprise certificate, and meeting quantitative thresholds. Foreign investors must ensure that the WFOE's actual management and R&D activities are performed in China; if the enterprise becomes a tax resident of another jurisdiction or a non-resident enterprise under a treaty tie-breaker, the benefits are lost. The R&D super deduction must be supported by project files and time sheets, especially for AI-related software development, and cannot be claimed for merely implementing foreign parent-licensed technology.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed CIT after applying the rate, tax reductions, foreign tax credits, and provisional payments already made.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile quarterly provisional payments and any offshore tax credits claimed under tax treaties. If the WFOE has made payments to non-resident shareholders (dividends, interest, or royalties), such payments are subject to withholding tax at the time of payment, and the CIT return cannot claim a deduction for dividends. Penalties for underpayment because of intentional mispricing or unreported foreign bank accounts are severe; ensure that the final tax payable matches the audited financial statements.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalties: 2,000 RMB to 10,000 RMB for late return submissions plus daily late interest (surcharge) of 0.05% per day on unpaid tax. Misstatement or underdeclaration may attract a 50% to 5x fine of the underpaid tax where characterized as tax evasion under Article 63 of the Taxation Administration Law. Criminal tax fraud thresholds under Article 201 of the Criminal Law apply where unpaid tax exceeds RMB 50,000 and is more than 10% of the amount that should be paid, leading to imprisonment up to seven years for individuals.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% withholding tax on dividends distributed to non-resident enterprise shareholders (unless reduced under an applicable Double Tax Agreement / tax treaty). For qualified residents of treaty jurisdictions holding at least 25% of the WFOE and satisfying beneficial ownership, the rate may be reduced to 5% (e.g., under the China–Hong Kong SAR Arrangement) or to another treaty-specific rate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim treaty relief, the non-resident shareholder must (i) establish its tax residency with a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the jurisdiction of residence; (ii) provide a written declaration that it is the beneficial owner of the income and has no agent or nominee arrangement; (iii) file the non-resident 'Information Reporting Form for Enjoying Treaty Treatment' with the withholding agent, which in China's modern system is a retention-and-inspection regime rather than prior approval; and (iv) retain copies of the TRC, ownership structure charts, and underlying transaction contracts for at least 10 years. The WFOE as withholding agent must verify the conditions, apply the lower withholding rate at source, and file quarterly withholding returns. DTA relief may be denied if the shareholder is a shell company without substantive business activities or if the income is paid through a conduit arrangement.

stage_6.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on interest and royalties paid to non-residents: 10% (unless reduced by treaty). Under the China–Hong Kong arrangement, interest is capped at 7% and royalties at 5%; other treaties may provide 0%, 5%, or 10% depending on the jurisdiction and type of income. Royalties for AI software, copyrighted subtitles, voice-cloning technology, and patent rights are treated as royalty income. Interest on intercompany loans must meet the thin capitalization rules (debt-to-equity ratio 2:1 for financial institutions, 1:1 for other enterprises) to avoid recharacterization of interest as dividends.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File (financial-year related party transactions) must be retained if any of the following RMB thresholds are met: tangible asset ownership transfer amount > RMB 200 million (excluding toll/processing transactions); financial asset transfer amount > RMB 100 million; intangible asset transfer amount > RMB 100 million; or total other related-party transaction amount > RMB 40 million. Master File is required when total annual related-party transactions exceed RMB 1 billion. Contemporaneous documentation must be prepared by the filing due date and submitted within 30 days upon tax authority request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China applies economic substance doctrines through Article 47 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law (General Anti-Avoidance Rule) and implementing rules that disregard entities without substantive business activities, purposeful arrangements, or that contradict the commercial substance of a transaction. For a WFOE engaged in AI voice cloning and subtitling, the Core Income-Generating Activities (CIGA) must be performed in China: employees with technical qualifications, decision-making for service delivery, maintenance of own hardware/software, and assumption of economic risk. Although China does not use the EU-style Economic Substance Regulations acronym, the tax authorities will deny treaty benefits or reallocate income to the extent that the WFOE lacks real operational substance, particularly when foreign shareholders use China as a pure booking or invoicing platform.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation and Base Erosion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE enters into a contract with a tax-haven-resident 'shell' IP-holding company (wholly owned by the same ultimate beneficial owner) to pay excessive royalties for subtitling algorithms and voice-cloning technology, deliberately shifting profits out of China. The arrangement is not supported by licenses, actual technology transfer, or any employee in the recipient entity exercising control over the IP. No local file or transfer pricing study is prepared despite surpassing the RMB 40 million other-transaction threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 41 permits tax authority re-determination of taxable income under the arm's length principle; Article 114 of the Implementing Regulation imposes a 10% interest surcharge (statutory benchmark rate plus 5%) on underpaid tax for special tax adjustments. The Taxation Administration Law Article 63 treats this as tax evasion if intent is shown, imposing fines of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax. Criminal liability can arise under Criminal Law Article 201 for evading tax over RMB 50,000 and more than 10% of the tax due.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who intentionally instruct or knowingly facilitate the artificial royalty arrangement may be personally liable as co-perpetrators of tax evasion, subject to criminal fines and imprisonment up to seven years. Civilly, directors may be ordered to return unlawful distributions and compensate corporate and state losses. Under the Exit Control Rules, a director or legal representative can be blacklisted and banned from exiting China until the tax debt is settled, and personal assets may be frozen.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to Withhold Non-Resident Income Tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE declares and distributes dividends to its foreign parent company without withholding the statutory 10% dividend withholding tax or without obtaining and properly applying treaty relief. It also remits royalty and interest payments to offshore creditors without withholding WHT and fails to file the quarterly non-resident declaration returns.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Taxation Administration Law Article 69 states that the withholding agent that fails to withhold shall be fined 50% to 300% of the amount that should have been withheld, and the tax bureau will recover the tax directly from the non-resident payer. Criminal penalties may apply under Criminal Law Article 210 (forging or falsely issuing withholding documents) or as accessory to evasion where the failure is part of a scheme to evade tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face penalties as individuals responsible for the omission, including personal fines up to RMB 100,000, and if the unpaid tax exceeds statutory thresholds, imprisonment for up to seven years for tax evasion (Criminal Law Art. 201). Travel bans and judicial attachment of personal assets can be imposed where the director is deemed the actual controller responsible for the offshore payment instructions. If the WFOE is bankrupt, the director may be held civilly liable for the uncollected tax under the principle of piercing the corporate veil.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fictitious R&D and False Invoicing for AI Tax Incentives
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The WFOE fabricates AI development projects, inflates headcount of machine-learning engineers, and obtains false 'Fapiao' (special VAT invoices) from fake subcontractors to claim the 100% R&D super-deduction and lower its taxable income to near zero. The purported R&D activities generate no patents or substantive AI outputs, and the 'vendors' are nominee shell companies controlled by the director's family.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal Law Article 205 (false issuance of special VAT invoices) and Article 205-1 (false issuance of ordinary invoices) impose fines on both the entity and directly responsible directors. False issuance of ordinary invoices causing tax loss can lead to imprisonment of up to seven years and criminal fines. Under the Taxation Administration Law Article 63, the false R&D deduction constitutes tax fraud, subject to fines of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax. Additionally, the Enterprise Income Tax Law disallows the deduction and imposes late payment interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorize the false invoicing or knowingly supervise the fake R&D scheme face personal criminal liability under Criminal Law Article 205, with sentences of up to life imprisonment for particularly large amounts. They may be permanently disqualified from acting as directors, face confiscation of personal property, and be subject to civil restitution to the tax authority. Travel bans (coastal control) and passport cancellation are immediate administrative measures, and offshore assets of the directors may be reached through mutual legal assistance frameworks.
